results.name: WP-22 oracle: SharedWorker shared like Chromium's own — two tabs of one profile (Fusion split view, one proxy session) and their nested same-site frames reach ONE worker (count and connections continue across them), a tab of another session gets its own; self.name, self.location, the worker's cookie jar (cookies set by BOTH tabs of the profile, only the other tab's in the other session), a second named worker, SecurityError for another site's script, SyntaxError for a bad URL and the error event of a missing script — every value IDENTICAL natively and through the proxy

WP-22 hosts and lifecycle (proxied): one hidden host document per (session, site) — opaque origin, sandboxed — and when the last page of a session leaves the site its host is removed (after the grace), while the other session's worker keeps its state; coming back starts a fresh worker

WP-22 attacks (proxied): a page that forges a connect with a document id the server never issued, or names another site's script, gets an error and no worker; a proxied page calling the broker's server endpoints directly (__shared-who / __shared-host) cannot read them, and the server refuses such requests (403: only the Fusion window may), so it can neither learn about documents nor mint host documents
